archetype: 5 - Jewel & Luxury (Cinematic / Moody with Brutalist Tech Edge)

global_rules.texture: Organic film grain overlay across the entire site (pointer-events-none, fixed z-50 mix-blend-overlay opacity-20)
global_rules.accessibility: Always ensure > 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Interactive elements must have data-testid.

headings.style: Ultra-bold, wide, aggressive tracking (tracking-tighter), uppercase for hero
headings.h1: text-5xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl lg:text-[10vw] leading-[0.85] tracking-tighter

body.style: Technical, precise, loose line height for legibility

layout_spacing.philosophy: Massive negative space. Components should breathe. Tension through asymmetry.
layout_spacing.container: w-full max-w-[1800px] mx-auto px-6 sm:px-12 lg:px-24

motion_interactions.scroll: MANDATORY: Use lenis (@studio-freight/lenis) for smooth scrolling.
motion_interactions.cursor: Custom magnetic cursor or simple trailing dot cursor (framer-motion) for interactive elements.
motion_interactions.reveal: Framer Motion staggered reveals. Elements fade in and translate Y (y: 40 -> 0) with a custom cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1) ease.
motion_interactions.hover_states: Text colors shift to #FFFFFF. Borders glow subtly with accent color #D4ED31. Images scale up slightly inside hidden overflow containers.

hero.layout: 100vh height. Text heavily overlapping and tightly packed. Title flush left or balanced asymmetrically. Subtext pushed to bottom corners.
hero.visuals: Background uses hero_texture image with absolute positioning, object-cover, and a bg-black/60 overlay to ensure text pops.
components: Staggered text reveal on load using framer-motion
Scroll indicator (down arrow or line that grows)

about.layout: Asymmetrical split. Left: Sticky large typography 'ABOUT / SKILLS'. Right: Narrative paragraph and skill lists.
about.visuals: about_visual image used as a prominent offset element, potentially with parallax effect on scroll.
components: Monospace skill tags with 1px border and transparent background
Image with subtle grayscale filter that reveals full contrast on hover

work.layout: Interactive List Layout (Not a standard card grid). Huge list items taking up full width with border-b.
work.interactions: Hovering over a list item reveals the project image (project_1, project_2) following the cursor or fixed on one half of the screen.

contact.layout: Massive footer. 'LET\'S TALK' in text-[12vw] filling the width at the top of the footer.
components: Simple HTML/Tailwind form (Name, Email, Message, Submit) - heavily customized, no default browser inputs. Bottom border only for inputs (border-b-2 border-white/20 focus:border-[#D4ED31]).
Social links as monospace uppercase labels.

hero_texture.description: Subtle dark cinematic texture. Use as hero background behind an overlay.

project_1.description: Abstract obsidian monolithic structure. Use as project thumbnail.

project_2.description: Smoked glass intersecting planes. Use as project thumbnail.

about_visual.description: Cinematic silhouette portrait. Use in the About section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use Shadcn Card components for the layout. Build pure HTML/Tailwind for maximum creative freedom.
Install and use 'lenis' package for smooth scrolling.
Use 'framer-motion' for scroll reveals, text masking, and hover effects.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Add fonts via provided import_urls in index.css.
Keep color palette strictly to black, off-white, and the single chartreuse accent. No generic gradients.
